l.i: Atque rapax populata fines BELLONA nostros perderet ignibus. Sed tristis ausa est tunc SOLYMÆ mala, Casusque funestos SYONIS AVSONIO resonare plectro, Lamenta victis quæ popularibus VATES HEBRÆO carmine condidit, Quum templa conflagrare flammis ASSYRIIS SOLYMÆA vidit. Viditque vinctos ABRAMIDAS pati Nutus feroces iussaque Barbara. Hæc dona PHOEBVS iussit auctor (Parua licet) tibi dedicare, PRINCEPS potentum progenies DVCVM. PRINCEPS superbis stemmatibus cluens: Quem spondet IMPVBES futurum Laude parem PROAVIS IVVENTA Formata dignis artibus. Vuidum Sic VER, tepenti quod ZEPHIRVS frequēs Demulcet aura: cuique candens ÆTHRA fauet, pluuiique rores, Sperare messes agricolam facit Benigniores: atque THYONEI Simul refundit largiore

page.notes: Set in italic with capitals in roman, in the usual style of a poem printed in small capitals. The line breaks and indents of the verse are not reproduced; the whole poem is one paragraph. "Vuidum" is printed with a capital V followed by u, and I have copied it as printed. "frequēs" is printed with a tilde-like mark over the e, which I have read as a macron. No doubtful letters are otherwise marked.
